sanskrit: tvaṁ hy a̍gne pratha̱mo ma̱notā̱syā dhi̱yo abha̍vo dasma̱ hotā̍ | tvaṁ sī̍ṁ vṛṣann akṛṇor du̱ṣṭarī̍tu̱ saho̱ viśva̍smai̱ saha̍se̱ saha̍dhyai ||
english: For thou, O Agni, wast the first to take thought of this hymn, and becamest the wondrous Hotṛ. Thou, O bull, hast made thy strength hard to overcome, thy might for every might, to be with every might.

sanskrit: adhā̱ hotā̱ ny a̍sīdo̱ yajī̍yān i̱ḻas pa̱da i̱ṣaya̱nn īḍya̱ḥ san | taṁ tvā̱ nara̍ḥ pratha̱maṁ de̍va̱yanto̍ ma̱ho rā̱ye ci̱taya̍nto̱ anu̍ gman ||
english: Then the Hotṛ, most worthy of worship, sat down in the seat of Iḷā, driving refreshment forward and being praised. Men devoted to the gods followed thee, the first, with minds fixed on great wealth.

sanskrit: vṛ̱teva̱ yanta̍m ba̱hubhi̍r vasa̱vyai̱3̱̍s tve ra̱yiṁ jā̍gṛ̱vāṁso̱ anu̍ gman | ruśa̍ntam a̱gniṁ da̍rśa̱tam bṛ̱hanta̍ṁ va̱pāva̍ntaṁ vi̱śvahā̍ dīdi̱vāṁsa̍m ||
english: Like a herd following one who goes with many cattle, the wakeful ones followed the wealth in thee. Agni, the shining, the visible, the great, endowed with fat, shining every day.

sanskrit: pa̱daṁ de̱vasya̱ nama̍sā̱ vyanta̍ḥ śrava̱syava̱ḥ śrava̍ āpa̱nn amṛ̍ktam | nāmā̍ni cid dadhire ya̱jñiyā̍ni bha̱drāyā̍ṁ te raṇayanta̱ saṁdṛ̍ṣṭau ||
english: Seeking with reverence the footstep of the god, the glory-seeking ones obtained unfading fame. They assumed the sacred names; at thy auspicious appearance they made merry.

sanskrit: tvāṁ va̍rdhanti kṣi̱taya̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyāṁ tvāṁ rāya̍ u̱bhayā̍so̱ janā̍nām | tvaṁ trā̱tā ta̍raṇe̱ cetyo̍ bhūḥ pi̱tā mā̱tā sada̱m in mānu̍ṣāṇām ||
english: The settlements on earth magnify thee; the riches of the people on both sides magnify thee. Thou becamest a protector to be remembered at the crossing; father and mother art thou always to human beings.

sanskrit: sa̱pa̱ryeṇya̱ḥ sa pri̱yo vi̱kṣv a1̱̍gnir hotā̍ ma̱ndro ni ṣa̍sādā̱ yajī̍yān | taṁ tvā̍ va̱yaṁ dama̱ ā dī̍di̱vāṁsa̱m upa̍ jñu̱bādho̱ nama̍sā sadema ||
english: Worthy of worship, he is dear in the settlements; Agni the Hotṛ, the joyous, the most worship-worthy, has sat down. We would sit with bent knees before thee who shinest in the house, with homage.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā̍ va̱yaṁ su̱dhyo̱3̱̍ navya̍m agne sumnā̱yava̍ īmahe deva̱yanta̍ḥ | tvaṁ viśo̍ anayo̱ dīdyā̍no di̱vo a̍gne bṛha̱tā ro̍ca̱nena̍ ||
english: Thee, O Agni, the new one, we implore, we who have good thoughts and seek thy grace, longing for the gods. Thou, O Agni, hast led the clans, shining with the great light of heaven.

sanskrit: vi̱śāṁ ka̱viṁ vi̱śpati̱ṁ śaśva̍tīnāṁ ni̱tośa̍naṁ vṛṣa̱bhaṁ ca̍rṣaṇī̱nām | pretī̍ṣaṇim i̱ṣaya̍ntam pāva̱kaṁ rāja̍ntam a̱gniṁ ya̍ja̱taṁ ra̍yī̱ṇām ||
english: The seer of the clans, lord of the enduring peoples, the impeller, the bull of the human tribes — him who urges forward, who drives on refreshment, the purifying, resplendent Agni, the adorable bestower of riches.

sanskrit: so a̍gna īje śaśa̱me ca̱ marto̱ yas ta̱ āna̍ṭ sa̱midhā̍ ha̱vyadā̍tim | ya āhu̍ti̱m pari̱ vedā̱ namo̍bhi̱r viśvet sa vā̱mā da̍dhate̱ tvota̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, that mortal has sacrificed and toiled, who has attained to thee with fuel and gift of oblation — whoever knows the offering round about with reverence, all desires that one obtains, aided by thee.

sanskrit: a̱smā u̍ te̱ mahi̍ ma̱he vi̍dhema̱ namo̍bhir agne sa̱midho̱ta ha̱vyaiḥ | vedī̍ sūno sahaso gī̱rbhir u̱kthair ā te̍ bha̱drāyā̍ṁ suma̱tau ya̍tema ||
english: For thee in return we would do service greatly, for the great one, with homages, O Agni, with fuel and with oblations. O son of strength, we who know, with hymns and songs of praise, would come to thy auspicious gracious thought.

sanskrit: ā yas ta̱tantha̱ roda̍sī̱ vi bhā̱sā śravo̍bhiś ca śrava̱sya1̱̍s taru̍traḥ | bṛ̱hadbhi̱r vājai̱ḥ sthavi̍rebhir a̱sme re̱vadbhi̍r agne vita̱raṁ vi bhā̍hi ||
english: Thou who hast stretched out both world-halves with thy brilliance, and who art the rescuer that seeks fame through praises — with great, vigorous, shining prizes, O Agni, shine forth more widely upon us.

sanskrit: nṛ̱vad va̍so̱ sada̱m id dhe̍hy a̱sme bhūri̍ to̱kāya̱ tana̍yāya pa̱śvaḥ | pū̱rvīr iṣo̍ bṛha̱tīr ā̱re-a̍ghā a̱sme bha̱drā sau̍śrava̱sāni̍ santu ||
english: Always kindle for us, O Vasu, manly gifts; much cattle for our offspring and our descendants. May many refreshments, great, far from evil, auspicious glories of good renown be ours.

sanskrit: pu̱rūṇy a̍gne puru̱dhā tvā̱yā vasū̍ni rājan va̱sutā̍ te aśyām | pu̱rūṇi̱ hi tve pu̍ruvāra̱ santy agne̱ vasu̍ vidha̱te rāja̍ni̱ tve ||
english: O Agni, O king, through thee the many, many riches and the abundant wealth: may I obtain thy store of goods. For many desirable things are in thee, O much-desired Agni; wealth for the worshipper is in thee, O king.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi kṣaita̍va̱d yaśo 'gne̍ mi̱tro na patya̍se | tvaṁ vi̍carṣaṇe̱ śravo̱ vaso̍ pu̱ṣṭiṁ na pu̍ṣyasi ||
english: For thou, O Agni, rulest over glory as Mitra over a principality. Thou, O all-beholding Vasu, nourishest fame like nourishment.

sanskrit: tvāṁ hi ṣmā̍ carṣa̱ṇayo̍ ya̱jñebhi̍r gī̱rbhir īḻa̍te | tvāṁ vā̱jī yā̍ty avṛ̱ko ra̍ja̱stūr vi̱śvaca̍rṣaṇiḥ ||
english: Thee verily do the tribes implore with sacrifices and with hymns. To thee comes the vigorous one, the wolf-free, cleaving through the air, all-beholding.

sanskrit: sa̱joṣa̍s tvā di̱vo naro̍ ya̱jñasya̍ ke̱tum i̍ndhate | yad dha̱ sya mānu̍ṣo̱ jana̍ḥ sumnā̱yur ju̱hve a̍dhva̱re ||
english: With united desire, the men of heaven kindle thee, the banner of sacrifice — when that human folk, longing for thy grace, offers oblation at the rite.

sanskrit: ṛdha̱d yas te̍ su̱dāna̍ve dhi̱yā marta̍ḥ śa̱śama̍te | ū̱tī ṣa bṛ̍ha̱to di̱vo dvi̱ṣo aṁho̱ na ta̍rati ||
english: The mortal who prospers through thought for thee, O liberal giver, and who toils — he crosses with the help of the great heaven, even as one crosses enmity and distress.

sanskrit: sa̱midhā̱ yas ta̱ āhu̍ti̱ṁ niśi̍ti̱m martyo̱ naśa̍t | va̱yāva̍nta̱ṁ sa pu̍ṣyati̱ kṣaya̍m agne śa̱tāyu̍ṣam ||
english: The mortal who with fuel attains the sharpened oblation to thee — O Agni, he nourishes a dwelling full of abundance, for a hundred autumns.

sanskrit: tve̱ṣas te̍ dhū̱ma ṛ̍ṇvati di̱vi ṣañ chu̱kra āta̍taḥ | sūro̱ na hi dyu̱tā tvaṁ kṛ̱pā pā̍vaka̱ roca̍se ||
english: Thy fearsome smoke rolls up and is spread bright in the sky. Like the sun with its brilliance, thou shinest gracefully, O Pāvaka.

sanskrit: adhā̱ hi vi̱kṣv īḍyo 'si̍ pri̱yo no̱ ati̍thiḥ | ra̱ṇvaḥ pu̱rī̍va̱ jūrya̍ḥ sū̱nur na tra̍ya̱yāyya̍ḥ ||
english: Verily thou art to be praised in the settlements, thou art our beloved guest — delightful, to be cherished as a homestead, to be saved as a son.

sanskrit: kratvā̱ hi droṇe̍ a̱jyase 'gne̍ vā̱jī na kṛtvya̍ḥ | pari̍jmeva sva̱dhā gayo 'tyo̱ na hvā̱ryaḥ śiśu̍ḥ ||
english: For by wisdom in the trough thou art anointed, O Agni, a vigorous one capable of deeds — like a house with its own realm going everywhere, like a swift horse easy to call, a young one.

sanskrit: tvaṁ tyā ci̱d acyu̱tāgne̍ pa̱śur na yava̍se | dhāmā̍ ha̱ yat te̍ ajara̱ vanā̍ vṛ̱ścanti̱ śikva̍saḥ ||
english: Thou, O Agni, dost consume even those unshaken things, like a beast in a pasture. For, O ageless one, the skillful ones cut the forests that are thy abode.

sanskrit: veṣi̱ hy a̍dhvarīya̱tām agne̱ hotā̱ dame̍ vi̱śām | sa̱mṛdho̍ viśpate kṛṇu ju̱ṣasva̍ ha̱vyam a̍ṅgiraḥ ||
english: For thou goest as Hotṛ of those performing the rite, in the house of the clans. Grant prosperity, O lord of the clan; be pleased with the oblation, O Aṅgiras.

sanskrit: acchā̍ no mitramaho deva de̱vān agne̱ voca̍ḥ suma̱tiṁ roda̍syoḥ | vī̱hi sva̱stiṁ su̍kṣi̱tiṁ di̱vo nṝn dvi̱ṣo aṁhā̍ṁsi duri̱tā ta̍rema̱ tā ta̍rema̱ tavāva̍sā tarema ||
english: O Agni, friend-great one, tell the gods of the good will of the two world-halves toward us. Bring welfare, a good dwelling for the men of heaven; may we cross over hatreds, distresses, and evils — may we cross them, cross them with thy protection.

sanskrit: agne̱ sa kṣe̍ṣad ṛta̱pā ṛ̍te̱jā u̱ru jyoti̍r naśate deva̱yuṣ ṭe̍ | yaṁ tvam mi̱treṇa̱ varu̍ṇaḥ sa̱joṣā̱ deva̱ pāsi̱ tyaja̍sā̱ marta̱m aṁha̍ḥ ||
english: O Agni, he will dwell who is the guardian of Order, born of Order; he who is devoted to the gods and yearning for thee attains wide light. That mortal whom thou, O god, together with Mitra, and Varuṇa in unison, guardest from trouble with thy sharp power.

sanskrit: ī̱je ya̱jñebhi̍ḥ śaśa̱me śamī̍bhir ṛ̱dhadvā̍rāyā̱gnaye̍ dadāśa | e̱vā ca̱na taṁ ya̱śasā̱m aju̍ṣṭi̱r nāṁho̱ marta̍ṁ naśate̱ na pradṛ̍ptiḥ ||
english: He has sacrificed with sacrifices, toiled with labors, and presented gifts to Agni of the prospering gate. Thus indeed neither dishonor among the glorious, nor distress, nor arrogance overtakes that mortal.

sanskrit: sūro̱ na yasya̍ dṛśa̱tir a̍re̱pā bhī̱mā yad eti̍ śuca̱tas ta̱ ā dhīḥ | heṣa̍svataḥ śu̱rudho̱ nāyam a̱ktoḥ kutrā̍ cid ra̱ṇvo va̍sa̱tir va̍ne̱jāḥ ||
english: His appearance is sinless like the sun, fearsome when his flaming thought comes. His host does not neigh; yet this forest-dweller, pleasant in any dwelling, cannot be restrained by night.

sanskrit: ti̱gmaṁ ci̱d ema̱ mahi̱ varpo̍ asya̱ bhasa̱d aśvo̱ na ya̍masā̱na ā̱sā | vi̱jeha̍mānaḥ para̱śur na ji̱hvāṁ dra̱vir na drā̍vayati̱ dāru̱ dhakṣa̍t ||
english: His great form moves even where sharp, blazing with its mouth like a horse tossing its jaws. Lolling his tongue as he goes, like an axe he is about to set fire to the wood, like a metal-worker he makes it run.

sanskrit: sa id aste̍va̱ prati̍ dhād asi̱ṣyañ chiśī̍ta̱ tejo 'ya̍so̱ na dhārā̍m | ci̱tradhra̍jatir ara̱tir yo a̱ktor ver na dru̱ṣadvā̍ raghu̱patma̍jaṁhāḥ ||
english: Like a shooter he has set himself in place, ready to shoot; he sharpens his gleam like the edge of iron. He who has a wonderful banner, the fire-stick that cannot be contained by night, like a bird swiftly alighting with swift flight of wings.

sanskrit: sa ī̍ṁ re̱bho na prati̍ vasta u̱srāḥ śo̱ciṣā̍ rārapīti mi̱trama̍hāḥ | nakta̱ṁ ya ī̍m aru̱ṣo yo divā̱ nṝn ama̍rtyo aru̱ṣo yo divā̱ nṝn ||
english: He, the great friend, covers himself against the dawns like a singer, and glitters with his flame. The ruddy immortal one who by night, the ruddy one who by day guides men — the immortal ruddy one who by day guides men.

sanskrit: di̱vo na yasya̍ vidha̱to navī̍no̱d vṛṣā̍ ru̱kṣa oṣa̍dhīṣu nūnot | ghṛṇā̱ na yo dhraja̍sā̱ patma̍nā̱ yann ā roda̍sī̱ vasu̍nā̱ daṁ su̱patnī̍ ||
english: His worshipper bellows forth newness like the sky; the bull, the glittering one, has bellowed in the plants. He who goes with glowing course like sunlight in his path fills both world-halves with wealth, making them good consorts.

sanskrit: dhāyo̍bhir vā̱ yo yujye̍bhir a̱rkair vi̱dyun na da̍vidyo̱t svebhi̱ḥ śuṣmai̍ḥ | śardho̍ vā̱ yo ma̱rutā̍ṁ ta̱takṣa̍ ṛ̱bhur na tve̱ṣo ra̍bhasā̱no a̍dyaut ||
english: He who flashes with his own energies like lightning, whether with refreshments or with united rays — or who has fashioned the troop of the Maruts, blazed like a skillful artisan, fierce and impetuous.

sanskrit: yathā̍ hota̱r manu̍ṣo de̱vatā̍tā ya̱jñebhi̍ḥ sūno sahaso̱ yajā̍si | e̱vā no̍ a̱dya sa̍ma̱nā sa̍mā̱nān u̱śann a̍gna uśa̱to ya̍kṣi de̱vān ||
english: As thou, O Hotṛ, hast sacrificed to the gods with the sacrifices of Manu, O son of strength — so do thou today, O Agni, sacrifice to those same gods for us equally, desiring the desiring ones.

sanskrit: sa no̍ vi̱bhāvā̍ ca̱kṣaṇi̱r na vasto̍r a̱gnir va̱ndāru̱ vedya̱ś cano̍ dhāt | vi̱śvāyu̱r yo a̱mṛto̱ martye̍ṣūṣa̱rbhud bhūd ati̍thir jā̱tave̍dāḥ ||
english: May Agni, the far-shining, worthy of praise, perceptible like the morning sky, grant us comfort who knows all things. He who is all-living, immortal among mortals, who rises at dawn, who is a guest — Jātavedas.

sanskrit: dyāvo̱ na yasya̍ pa̱naya̱nty abhva̱m bhāsā̍ṁsi vaste̱ sūryo̱ na śu̱kraḥ | vi ya i̱noty a̱jara̍ḥ pāva̱ko 'śna̍sya cic chiśnathat pū̱rvyāṇi̍ ||
english: The skies wonder at his mightiness; he wears radiances like the bright sun. He who ageless and purifying fills all things, who shatters even the ancient things of the rock.

sanskrit: va̱dmā hi sū̍no̱ asy a̍dma̱sadvā̍ ca̱kre a̱gnir ja̱nuṣājmānna̍m | sa tvaṁ na̍ ūrjasana̱ ūrja̍ṁ dhā̱ rāje̍va jer avṛ̱ke kṣe̍ṣy a̱ntaḥ ||
english: For the praiseworthy one, the son, art thou; the fire-worshipper: Agni by birth has made food his seat. Be thou an energy-winner and grant us energy; like a king who subdues the enemy, mayst thou dwell within us without wolves.

sanskrit: niti̍kti̱ yo vā̍ra̱ṇam anna̱m atti̍ vā̱yur na rāṣṭry aty e̍ty a̱ktūn | tu̱ryāma̱ yas ta̍ ā̱diśā̱m arā̍tī̱r atyo̱ na hruta̱ḥ pata̍taḥ pari̱hrut ||
english: He who keeps sharpening his teeth and consumes the obstructing food; like Vāyu he surpasses all nights as sovereign. May we overcome the adversaries of thy commanded ones — he moves around like a swift horse falling and flying.

sanskrit: ā sūryo̱ na bhā̍nu̱madbhi̍r a̱rkair agne̍ ta̱tantha̱ roda̍sī̱ vi bhā̱sā | ci̱tro na̍ya̱t pari̱ tamā̍ṁsy a̱ktaḥ śo̱ciṣā̱ patma̍nn auśi̱jo na dīya̍n ||
english: Like the sun with its luminous rays, O Agni, thou hast stretched out both world-halves with brilliance. The brilliant night-flame guides around the darknesses; like Auśija, flying on his path of flame.

sanskrit: tvāṁ hi ma̱ndrata̍mam arkaśo̱kair va̍vṛ̱mahe̱ mahi̍ na̱ḥ śroṣy a̍gne | indra̱ṁ na tvā̱ śava̍sā de̱vatā̍ vā̱yum pṛ̍ṇanti̱ rādha̍sā̱ nṛta̍māḥ ||
english: Thee we have chosen as the most joyful with rays of song — hear us greatly, O Agni. With strength, like Indra; the most manly ones fill thee as a divinity, like Vāyu, with bounty.

sanskrit: nū no̍ agne 'vṛ̱kebhi̍ḥ sva̱sti veṣi̍ rā̱yaḥ pa̱thibhi̱ḥ parṣy aṁha̍ḥ | tā sū̱ribhyo̍ gṛṇa̱te rā̍si su̱mnam made̍ma śa̱tahi̍māḥ su̱vīrā̍ḥ ||
english: Now, O Agni, with the wolf-free paths of welfare, go before us for riches; lead us across distress. Bestow that blessing on the generous patrons who praise thee; may we rejoice a hundred winters with good heroes.

sanskrit: hu̱ve va̍ḥ sū̱nuṁ saha̍so̱ yuvā̍na̱m adro̍ghavācam ma̱tibhi̱r yavi̍ṣṭham | ya inva̍ti̱ dravi̍ṇāni̱ prace̍tā vi̱śvavā̍rāṇi puru̱vāro̍ a̱dhruk ||
english: I call for you the youthful son of strength, the truthful of speech, youngest in thoughts — he who fills riches as the wise one, the all-desirable one, the much-desired, the blameless.

sanskrit: tve vasū̍ni purvaṇīka hotar do̱ṣā vasto̱r eri̍re ya̱jñiyā̍saḥ | kṣāme̍va̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ yasmi̱n saṁ saubha̍gāni dadhi̱re pā̍va̱ke ||
english: In thee are the treasures, O Hotṛ of the great banner; the adorable ones have stirred at evening and at morning. In thee as in earth all the worlds, all good fortunes, have been placed — in thee the purifying one.

sanskrit: tvaṁ vi̱kṣu pra̱diva̍ḥ sīda ā̱su kratvā̍ ra̱thīr a̍bhavo̱ vāryā̍ṇām | ata̍ inoṣi vidha̱te ci̍kitvo̱ vy ā̍nu̱ṣag jā̍tavedo̱ vasū̍ni ||
english: Thou hast sat of old in these settlements; by wisdom thou becamest the charioteer of desirable things. From there, O Jātavedas, thou who knowest, fillest the worshipper with riches, in succession one after another.

sanskrit: yo na̱ḥ sanu̍tyo abhi̱dāsa̍d agne̱ yo anta̍ro mitramaho vanu̱ṣyāt | tam a̱jare̍bhi̱r vṛṣa̍bhi̱s tava̱ svais tapā̍ tapiṣṭha̱ tapa̍sā̱ tapa̍svān ||
english: Whoever from afar attacks us, O Agni, whoever among those near, O great friend, would harm us — with thy own ageless bulls, O most burning one, burn him, thou who hast burning power.

sanskrit: yas te̍ ya̱jñena̍ sa̱midhā̱ ya u̱kthair a̱rkebhi̍ḥ sūno sahaso̱ dadā̍śat | sa martye̍ṣv amṛta̱ prace̍tā rā̱yā dyu̱mnena̱ śrava̍sā̱ vi bhā̍ti ||
english: He who has served thee with sacrifice, with fuel, with hymns and praises, O son of strength — that one among mortals shines, O immortal wise one, with wealth, with glory, with fame.

sanskrit: sa tat kṛ̍dhīṣi̱tas tūya̍m agne̱ spṛdho̍ bādhasva̱ saha̍sā̱ saha̍svān | yac cha̱syase̱ dyubhi̍r a̱kto vaco̍bhi̱s taj ju̍ṣasva jari̱tur ghoṣi̱ manma̍ ||
english: Do that swiftly when set in motion, O Agni; drive away the rivals with strength, O powerful one. What is praised by thee by days and night with words — be pleased with that, with the singer's hymn that resounds.

sanskrit: a̱śyāma̱ taṁ kāma̍m agne̱ tavo̱tī a̱śyāma̍ ra̱yiṁ ra̍yivaḥ su̱vīra̍m | a̱śyāma̱ vāja̍m a̱bhi vā̱jaya̍nto̱ 'śyāma̍ dyu̱mnam a̍jarā̱jara̍ṁ te ||
english: May we obtain that desire, O Agni, with thy help; O giver of riches, may we obtain wealth with good heroes. May we obtain vigour while winning vigour; may we obtain thine ageless and undying glory.

sanskrit: pra navya̍sā̱ saha̍saḥ sū̱num acchā̍ ya̱jñena̍ gā̱tum ava̍ i̱cchamā̍naḥ | vṛ̱ścadva̍naṁ kṛ̱ṣṇayā̍ma̱ṁ ruśa̍ntaṁ vī̱tī hotā̍raṁ di̱vyaṁ ji̍gāti ||
english: He who desires with a new hymn, seeking a path toward the son of strength, with sacrifice — goes to the wood-cleaving one, dark-hued by night, the shining divine Hotṛ who delights in the feast.

sanskrit: sa śvi̍tā̱nas ta̍nya̱tū ro̍cana̱sthā a̱jare̍bhi̱r nāna̍dadbhi̱r yavi̍ṣṭhaḥ | yaḥ pā̍va̱kaḥ pu̍ru̱tama̍ḥ pu̱rūṇi̍ pṛ̱thūny a̱gnir a̍nu̱yāti̱ bharva̍n ||
english: The youngest, the white one, the thunderer standing in the luminous sphere, resounding with ageless ones — he, the purifier, the most abundant Agni, follows all the wide and many things consuming them.

sanskrit: vi te̱ viṣva̱g vāta̍jūtāso agne̱ bhāmā̍saḥ śuce̱ śuca̍yaś caranti | tu̱vi̱mra̱kṣāso̍ di̱vyā nava̍gvā̱ vanā̍ vananti dhṛṣa̱tā ru̱janta̍ḥ ||
english: Thy flames driven by wind, O Agni, move hither and thither, the bright ones of the pure. The immensely anointed, divine, nine-fold ones overpower the forests, boldly breaking them.

sanskrit: ye te̍ śu̱krāsa̱ḥ śuca̍yaḥ śuciṣma̱ḥ kṣāṁ vapa̍nti̱ viṣi̍tāso̱ aśvā̍ḥ | adha̍ bhra̱mas ta̍ urvi̱yā vi bhā̍ti yā̱taya̍māno̱ adhi̱ sānu̱ pṛśne̍ḥ ||
english: Thy bright, pure, shining ones — like horses let loose — shear the earth. Then thy whirling brightness shines widely, as thou passest over the ridge of the dappled one.

sanskrit: adha̍ ji̱hvā pā̍patīti̱ pra vṛṣṇo̍ goṣu̱yudho̱ nāśani̍ḥ sṛjā̱nā | śūra̍syeva̱ prasi̍tiḥ kṣā̱tir a̱gner du̱rvartu̍r bhī̱mo da̍yate̱ vanā̍ni ||
english: Then the tongue of the bull flies forward like a thunderbolt hurled, fighting among the cows. Like the attack of a hero, the conquest of Agni — the fearsome, hard to restrain — devours the forests.

sanskrit: ā bhā̱nunā̱ pārthi̍vāni̱ jrayā̍ṁsi ma̱has to̱dasya̍ dhṛṣa̱tā ta̍tantha | sa bā̍dha̱svāpa̍ bha̱yā saho̍bhi̱ḥ spṛdho̍ vanu̱ṣyan va̱nuṣo̱ ni jū̍rva ||
english: With thy radiance thou hast boldly stretched out the earthly expanses of the great piercing one. Drive away the fearful things with thy forces; wishing to win, consume the rivals.

sanskrit: sa ci̍tra ci̱traṁ ci̱taya̍ntam a̱sme citra̍kṣatra ci̱trata̍maṁ vayo̱dhām | ca̱ndraṁ ra̱yim pu̍ru̱vīra̍m bṛ̱hanta̱ṁ candra̍ ca̱ndrābhi̍r gṛṇa̱te yu̍vasva ||
english: O brilliant one, O brilliant-dominioned one — the most brilliant, the giver of strength — grant us the brilliant, inspiring wealth, great, with many heroes; join to the singer who praises thee with brilliant praises.

sanskrit: mū̱rdhāna̍ṁ di̱vo a̍ra̱tim pṛ̍thi̱vyā vai̍śvāna̱ram ṛ̱ta ā jā̱tam a̱gnim | ka̱viṁ sa̱mrāja̱m ati̍thi̱ṁ janā̍nām ā̱sann ā pātra̍ṁ janayanta de̱vāḥ ||
english: The gods generated in the mouth the vessel: Agni Vaiśvānara, born in truth, the head of heaven, the fire-stick of earth — the wise one, the universal king, the guest of peoples.

sanskrit: nābhi̍ṁ ya̱jñānā̱ṁ sada̍naṁ rayī̱ṇām ma̱hām ā̍hā̱vam a̱bhi saṁ na̍vanta | vai̱śvā̱na̱raṁ ra̱thya̍m adhva̱rāṇā̍ṁ ya̱jñasya̍ ke̱tuṁ ja̍nayanta de̱vāḥ ||
english: The gods celebrated in unison the great invocation: the navel of sacrifices, the seat of riches — Vaiśvānara, the charioteer of rites, the banner of sacrifice, they generated.

sanskrit: tvad vipro̍ jāyate vā̱jy a̍gne̱ tvad vī̱rāso̍ abhimāti̱ṣāha̍ḥ | vaiśvā̍nara̱ tvam a̱smāsu̍ dhehi̱ vasū̍ni rājan spṛha̱yāyyā̍ṇi ||
english: From thee, O Agni, the inspired sage is born who wins prizes; from thee come heroes conquering enemies. O Vaiśvānara, O king, place in us the desirable riches.

sanskrit: tvāṁ viśve̍ amṛta̱ jāya̍māna̱ṁ śiśu̱ṁ na de̱vā a̱bhi saṁ na̍vante | tava̱ kratu̍bhir amṛta̱tvam ā̍ya̱n vaiśvā̍nara̱ yat pi̱tror adī̍deḥ ||
english: All the immortal gods celebrate thee at thy birth, as a young child. Through thy designs, O Vaiśvānara, they came to immortality — when thou didst shine for both parents.

sanskrit: vaiśvā̍nara̱ tava̱ tāni̍ vra̱tāni̍ ma̱hāny a̍gne̱ naki̱r ā da̍dharṣa | yaj jāya̍mānaḥ pi̱tror u̱pasthe 'vi̍ndaḥ ke̱tuṁ va̱yune̱ṣv ahnā̍m ||
english: O Vaiśvānara, O Agni, none has ever defied those great ordinances of thine — when at birth in the lap of both parents thou didst find the banner for the courses of the days.

sanskrit: vai̱śvā̱na̱rasya̱ vimi̍tāni̱ cakṣa̍sā̱ sānū̍ni di̱vo a̱mṛta̍sya ke̱tunā̍ | tasyed u̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̱nādhi̍ mū̱rdhani̍ va̱yā i̍va ruruhuḥ sa̱pta vi̱sruha̍ḥ ||
english: The ridges of heaven have been measured out by the eye of Vaiśvānara, by the banner of the immortal. On the very summit of that one, above all the worlds, seven streams have spread like branches.

sanskrit: vi yo rajā̱ṁsy ami̍mīta su̱kratu̍r vaiśvāna̱ro vi di̱vo ro̍ca̱nā ka̱viḥ | pari̱ yo viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni papra̱the 'da̍bdho go̱pā a̱mṛta̍sya rakṣi̱tā ||
english: He who of good insight measured out the realms of air, Vaiśvānara the wise who measured out the luminous regions of heaven — who has spread around all the worlds, the unwearied herdsman, the guardian of the immortal.
